text_block_list.text:
It had been a few days since we decided to
work 
together on the 『Hero Search』 and I was
meeting 
Zenno Rob Roy in the school library.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
……and so, with regards to our Hero, 
I decided to do some research on my own.
Um――

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
First,
the time of day when Trainer-san met that
Hero. 
It was probably during our free training
period, right?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
At that time,
lots of Uma Musume are entering 
and leaving,
so it's hard to narrow it down 
based on individual course usage records……
choice_data_list: So that's why we couldn't find any...
So that's why we couldn't find any...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm sorry…… t-then,
how about changing our approach!? 
How about starting by visiting each of the
training sites?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Normally, if they were using the course,
they would 
be one of our students so…… if our Hero is
there, 
you should be able to figure it out in a
glance!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Even if I'm the only one that thinks of them
that way, 
there are plenty of girls I could call a hero!
Um, for example――

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Even though everything she does seems 『A
little mysterious』, 
she's actually a reeeeally smart Uma
Musume……

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Even though she always falls just one step
short, 
she'll do everything in her power to keep
up and close the gap.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ……and then, there's Symboli Kris S-san.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
She's a senpai I look up to. 
Strong, fast,
and cool…… and she's already debuted.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Today,
that Kris S-san should be running so…… 
shall we go take a look, Trainer-san!?

Just like usual, after school,
the training course was 
crowded with students doing their free
training.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, Kris S-san is…… Ah! Over there……! 
I-it looks like she's already running!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa――

Such innate strength.
And such an overwhelming presence, 
however…… it seemed a little different from
the Hero at that time.

『She』 had more of a feeling that she would
never let go, of 
desperation and tenacity,
like she was obsessed with winning.

When I turned to Zenno Rob Roy to tell her
this――

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The way she's stepping in…… it may look like
she's 
relying solely on power,
but that's wrong. It seems calculated……

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
This is her approximate cooldown time…… and
her icing time is on 
the long side? Kris S-san,
she's managing her time very strictly.

While writing in her notebook,
she was watching training 
with a serious look in her eyes.
Her ears and tail 
flinched at the sound of the whistle.
Like this, it's almost like―

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Eh!? Ah, no…… 
today I'm taking a break from free
training!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
But, we can continue the Hero Search next
time…… Kris S-san 
doesn't seem to be the 『Hero』 that Trainer-san
was looking for.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
T-then…… I need to get going! 
I'll be heading off n-yow!

She was gone in an instant…… I was planning
on heading back too, 
but a familiar looking notebook was left
behind on the benches.

In a panic,
she must have left this behind. 
For now,
I opened it to confirm its owner――

It seemed to be about her observations of
Symboli Kris S' 
training today.
The page was completely filled.

text_block_list.name: Kind-looking Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! I'm just wondering but,
are you Rob Roy-san's――

I couldn't help but stare at the notebook.
These pages were 
filled with such dedication.
In that calm figure, where was she 
hiding all this passion?

text_block_list.name: Kind-looking Instructor
text_block_list.text: Ah…… Ummmm～! Hello there!

text_block_list.name: Kind-looking Instructor
text_block_list.text:
No worries! Um,
you were together with Rob Roy-san
right!? 
Are you perhaps, Rob Roy-san's trainer!?

Now that I think about it,
talk about an exclusive 
contract with Zenno Rob Roy never came up.
We 
were both just so focused on our Hero.

text_block_list.name: Kind-looking Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so that's not the case…… sorry for the
sudden question. I 
tend to be in charge of Rob Roy-san's training
often, but――

text_block_list.name: Kind-looking Instructor
text_block_list.text:
That girl, because of an injury,
she's passed 
on several Selection Races…… And most of
this 
time she hasn't seemed very energetic.

text_block_list.name: Kind-looking Instructor
text_block_list.text:
It's that time of year where most people
debut so 
she might be getting impatient.
The next Selection 
Race is still quite a ways off, after all.

text_block_list.name: Kind-looking Instructor
text_block_list.text:
However…… maybe it's because of that,
but it seems like she's 
performing worse than usual more often
now.

text_block_list.name: Kind-looking Instructor
text_block_list.text:
I talked to her about being more active in
this year's Sports 
Festival so she could attract the attention
of some trainers but――

text_block_list.name: Kind-looking Instructor
text_block_list.text:
――But lately,
it seems like she's doing less self
training. 
I'm worried she might be losing
motivation.

text_block_list.name: Kind-looking Instructor
text_block_list.text:
……because of that,
when I saw you I thought 
『It's her trainer!』 and got so excited.
I'm sorry.

The instructor bowed deeply.
Without a doubt, 
the reason her self training time was
decreasing 
was because of the 『Hero Search』.
However――

text_block_list.name: Kind-looking Instructor
text_block_list.text: Eh?

She probably has has her reasons for reducing
her self 
training time in order to accompany me in
the 『Hero Search』.
choice_data_list: She hasn't given up and isn't runn...

text_block_list.text:
After all―― in the pages of this notebook
she left behind, 
there was a strong impression of 『I want to
get stronger』.
